1.text: If 9x + 4 = 67, what is the value of 90x + 40?

2.text: In the figure, line p is parallel to line r, and line t intersects both lines. What is the value of x?

3.text: A length of 450 meters is equal to how many decimeters? (1 meter = 10 decimeters)

4.text: The equation 58 = 2x + 2y gives the perimeter of a rectangular garden that has length x, in feet, and width y, in feet. The width of the garden is 14 feet. What is the length, in feet, of the garden?

5.text: The relationship between the variables x and y is defined by an exponential equation. When x = 0, the value of y is 40, and for every increase in the value of x by 1, the corresponding value of y increases by 50% of its previous value. Which equation represents this relationship?

6.text: The function f is defined by f(x) = 1/(8x). What is the value of f(x) when x = 9?

7.text: The function f is defined by f(x) = 3x − 1/4. What is the y-intercept of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?

8.text:
x + 6y = 28
6y = 14

The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of x?

9.text: The length of a side of square X is 9 centimeters. The area of rectangle Y is 32 square centimeters. What is the total area, in square centimeters, of square X and rectangle Y?

10.text: During hibernation, American black bears do not eat or replenish calories. A certain black bear weighed 293 pounds when entering hibernation and lost weight at a mean rate of 0.9 pounds per day. At this rate, how many days after entering hibernation would the black bear weigh 230 pounds?

11.text: The complete graph of y = f(x) is shown. For how many values of x does f(x) = 0?

12.text:
b² + 4c = 7d

The given equation relates the real numbers b, c, and d, where d > (4/7)c. Which equation correctly expresses b in terms of c and d?

13.text:
x² − 81/16 = 0

How many distinct real solutions does the given equation have?

14.text: Triangles ABC and A′B′C′ are shown. Triangle ABC is dilated by a scale factor of 6 to form triangle A′B′C′. If the length of AB is 18, what is the length of A′B′?

15.text: What is the radius of the circle in the xy-plane defined by (x + 3)² + (y + 9)² = 361?

16.text: In the xy-plane, which of the following does NOT contain any points that are part of the solution set to 5x − 7y > 35?

choices.B: The region where x > 0 and y > 0
choices.C: The region where x < 0 and y < 0
choices.D: The region where x < 0 and y > 0

17.text:
The table shows the distribution of people in a certain city by age group.

If a person in this city is selected at random, which of the following is closest to the probability of selecting a person who is greater than 65 years old, given that the person is at least 18 years old?

18.text: Line h is defined by (1/2)x + (1/9)y − 54 = 0. Line j is perpendicular to line h in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line j?

19.text:
a, 26, 29, b, 31, 47, c

For the given data set, the data values are listed in ascending order, where a, b, and c are constants. For this data set, the mean is 36, the median is 29, and the range is 72. What is the value of c?

20.text: In triangle QRS shown, QR < RS. Which expression represents the length of QS?

21.text:
y = 9(a/7)^(x + c) − b

How many times does the graph of the given equation in the xy-plane cross the x-axis, where a, b, and c are positive constants such that a > 7 and b > c?

22.text: A certain town has an area of 4.29 square miles. What is the area, in square yards, of this town? (1 mile = 1,760 yards)
